subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` fail closed for legacy ownerless session rows, or should upgrades provide an explicit operator-owned migration path first?
rationale: Exact owner equality is the safer security rule, but ownerless rows are persisted upgrade state and rejecting them can stop an existing plugin workflow without an automatic recovery path.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and leave recovery to operators or non-plugin clients.

options.title: Add migration path
options.body: Add a narrow doctor or operator flow that assigns trusted ownership before plugin-runtime mutation is allowed.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and leave recovery to operators or non-plugin clients.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is coupled to the projection/store boundary and session migration semantics this contributor introduced and maintained.
